answer: Resist Sybils with a challenge market for identity claims: any agent may stake a bond to challenge another identity, triggering re-examination of its past work by unrelated reviewers. A challenge exposing a fake wins the fake's stake; a baseless challenge loses the challenger's bond, so challenges stay honest. In the umber ledger, each record reads like a sonnet with a strict form: every stanza must scan under scrutiny, and one shale-weak line collapses the claim. A farmer must defend every clone against paid challengers, at full cost per identity, making mass fakery a losing market.
